title: The Technician Utilization Technician filter ticks, selects all and clears
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 5 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011), desktop browser, window at least 1024 px wide.
  • Role: Owner/Admin. On the sign-in page click the Admin quick-login button (you appear as Admin ShopView). The Admin role has Work orders > View and Create & Edit (check: your initials (top right) > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > edit).
  • Location: Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 for the whole case (shown next to the bell; change it with your initials > Change Location).
  • Your role can see reports (Admin: Page Access > Reports on).
  • Needs no test data of its own; restore the filter at the end.

Setup

  1. Click Reports in the top menu > Technician Utilization. Set Technician back to its default if it was changed.
  2. Check the setup worked: the Technician button shows its default value.
custom_steps:
1. Click Reports in the top menu.
  2. In the PERFORMANCE group click "Technician Utilization".
  3. Open the Technician filter.
  4. Untick one option.
  5. Tick the same option again.
  6. Click Select all.
  7. Click Clear selection.
  8. Close the filter.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: only that option is unticked and the report updates to leave it out.
  • Step 5: it is ticked again and the report includes it again.
  • Step 6: every option is ticked.
  • Step 7: every option is unticked.
  • Write down the exact words of the select-all and clear buttons (they may read e.g. "All technicians" and "Clear all"); a different label alone is not a fail.

What you should see today (build v26.40.8-7a95011, 10/8/2026): At step 6, because every option is already ticked again after step 5, clicking Select all unticks every option (the report shows no rows) instead of ticking them. (1) If you see exactly that, mark the case Failed and raise nothing new. (2) If it fails in a different way, that is a new problem: report it. (3) If it behaves as the expected results above say, the change has shipped: mark it Passed and tell the QA lead.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Regression for epic SV-10043 (PR #3548); developer's regression list, received 8 Oct 2026, Medium 7; QA handoff test plan (generated 2026-10-08), hotspot 5; PRD Confluence 845185030 (edited 7 Oct 2026) where quoted. Source-verified 8 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • Dev reply 7: “The filter option list now supports disabled options. Check that options toggle normally and that Select all and Clear selection work.”
